question: Who the AI's air regrouping takes up, and what asks an agent to regroup its air.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_ManageAirUnits
addresses.comment:
**The theatre agent's air groups, every hour it holds one.** Body 0x4CD890-0x4D051D (trap 3: the `ret 8` at 0x4CEE68 is a shared epilogue mid-function). Gate: air_units_count (+0x104) >= 1. Four phases (FINDINGS-reorganise.md, FINDINGS-airnaval4.md): (1) 0x4CDA90 triage of +0xFC (kept by InsertUnitByRange, shortest range first, equals in slot 78's walk order): a dead join_air cancelled; at war, a group whose base province has enemy land units marching in is pulled out of any order but rebase_air and **sets force**; fitness bars 0.5/0.75 at air stance 2, else 0.7/0.85, halved for a CAG or interceptor group; an unfit busy group gets carrier_protection (all CAG, on a carrier) or none; a tired idle group at its base rests. (2) 0x4CE1E9 rebase, only with force: the list is +0x20C (strategic bomber or strategic_attack > 50000), +0x21C (naval bomber), +0x22C (transport plane, and the group is skipped while +0x16C is non-empty) or +0x1FC; the running best starts at the current base province with score 1e6, so the lowest listed base below 1e6 wins and the current one is not scored; a province with enemy land units marching in is skipped; score = the list's float, made (score + DistanceBetweenProvinces(the agent's HQ province, it)) x 0.5 when the group's parent is not at oob level 0; without a transport plane, x load where load = (this pass's arrivals + wings based there + the group's own unless based there) / the air base's level_current, when above 1.0; strict lower wins, first of equals in list (ascending) order; a winner other than the current base gets rebase_air and the arrivals tally moves. (3) 0x4CE64F split and merge. The hinge 0x4CEDA8: a regroup this pass (+0x88) with runs_units or allow_hq_reorg returns 1 with no missions; otherwise missions need force or war and air stance != 0. (4) 0x4CEE76 missions; **the anti-shipping budget is 4 x threatened_provinces_count (+0x1E4)** - the provinces of ours an enemy force at sea is heading for - so a tactical or CAS wing with sea attack flies naval missions only while such a threat stands. The returned bool is not read. The second argument is an int whose byte 3 is read uninitialised and ignored.

**The rebase's crowding, read again 2026-11-10** (`FINDINGS-liveread.md`, section 26): the wings based at a candidate are the regiments of every air unit on the list of the province's air base object (`CMapProvince +0x54`, its list at +4), nested under a headquarters or not, and the group's own are added unless that air base object is the group's (`CUnit +0x98`). On the save of July 1941 Brazil's three bases all score 10000 on every list, and the crowding alone keeps its groups where they are. The CAG test at 0x8CE240 skips a group with any carrier wing before anything else; a group whose own base is not on the list keeps that base when nothing scores under 1e6.

**The triage's four thresholds are two pairs, each used for strength and organisation alike** (`FINDINGS-liveread.md`, section 27): at plan air stance 2 a wing under 0.5 of either is unfit (`[ebp-28]`, `[ebp-3C]` from the float at 0x14BB304 in the running image) and one under 0.75 of either damaged or tired (`[ebp-80]`, `[ebp-A4]`); otherwise 0.7 and 0.85; all halved for a carrier's or an interceptor group. An unfit group under a busy order is called off; a group with any wing damaged or tired, idle at its own base, rests - that is the higher pair, not the unfit one. **'Dead' is COrder's target** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 51, live 2026-11-11): the triage resolves a join_air's +0x10/+0x14 pair (0x4CDAD8), which a load never sets, so every loaded join_air is called off on entering - Italy's 2nd Squadra Aerea joining the Eolo in August 1938 read id 0. **Read live 2026-11-12** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 56): the triage lists a group straight away (0x4CE0EC) where the country has neither at_war (+0xACC) nor in_undeclared_war (+0xACD) set, or the group has no base - the fitness, rest and order tests are a country at war's; the split and merge walk the triage's candidate list ([ebp-0xD0], EDI at 0x4CE148) with only the battle, at-own-base, blocking-order and handled tests, and the merge also sets regroup_air_pending at 0x4CEC0F.

addresses.name: CUnit_AttachToParent
addresses.comment: Hangs a unit under another in the order of battle: nothing unless they have one owner (+0x128) and the parent's oob_level (+0x1F4) is below the child's; the child leaves its old parent (CUnit_LeaveParent, notifying the AI where the AI agents differ); it is appended to the parent's children (+0x1E4) and its parent (+0x1E0) set; an AI agent of its own is let go; the nearest AI agent above it is marked. A fleet is level 5 and an air unit 6 (their constructors, 0x5CEE5F and 0x5D048E), so an air group goes under a fleet. 17 callers. The name is ours; the AI parts and the log line inside were not read closely. **The mark, read 2026-11-12** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 56): the nearest agent above the child (CUnit_FindNearestAgent), where it answers slot 65 (a unit agent), gets replan_subordinates (+0x86) = 1 at 0x1B99F6 and, where the child answers CUnit slot 17 IsAir, regroup_air_pending (+0x88) = 1 at 0x1B9A0A.

addresses.name: CAIUnit::Tick
addresses.comment: **Slot 73, the whole of what a unit agent does each hour** (0x4B0730 to the bare `ret` at 0x4B0D17), settled on the listing. hour = (tick - 43800000) % 24, days = (tick - 43800000) / 24, dayOfYear = days - (int)((int)(days / 365.0) * 365.0); staggers A0 = id%24, A3 = (id+3)%24, A6 = (id+6)%24, A9 = (id+9)%24 off CAIAgent +0x38. In order: (1) area_dirty (+0x87), or hour 1 on a dayOfYear divisible by 7: SetArea(this, GetArea()); (2) hour A0 or stance_set (+0x80) clear: UpdatePlanAxis (0x4C3330); (3) a land unit: its plan's objectives copied into CArmy +0x2EC; (4) **slot 82 every hour**, flag = hour A0 on a dayOfYear divisible by 9; (5) hour A3: slot 85; (6) **no unit: return**; (7) hour A9: RebuildFocusOwnerAreas (0x4B0D20); (8) F ('full pass') = hour A6 or full_pass_pending (+0x84); (9) +0x368 = 0x4DCAE0(this); (10) **slot 78 when replan_subordinates (+0x86) or hour A9 or F**; (11) CAIUnit_UpdateThreatenedProvinces (0x4B1820) every hour; (12) F: slot 79 (ManageExpeditions); (13) F, or air_target_lists_built (+0x83) clear: BuildAirTargetProvinceLists; (14) slot 80 runs when hold_provinces_built (+0x82) is clear, or the threatened-provinces list (+0x1E4) is non-empty, or F and (day of month % 7 == 0 or runs_units clear); (15) F: where the unit is level 0 and the area id is set, CAIUnit_ComputePlanForcesAndPower (0x4B60F0) for a played country, else CAIUnit_ComputePlanForces (0x4B5210); (16) F, or (the country at war, in an undeclared war or with provinces in revolt, and hour % 3 == 0): 0x4CC450, 0x4D7F80, 0x4CC690 where the vector +0x10C is non-empty, 0x4CC020; (17) F: CAIUnit_PullHeadquartersIn; (18) where this is the nearest agent at or above its unit (CUnit +0x198 up +0x1E0): 0x4C4370(this, hour A6), CAIUnit_ManageAirUnits(this, F), CAIUnit_ManageNavalUnits(this, F or replan_naval +0x85); (19) CAIUnit_MoveAgentUnitToCommandProvince every hour; (20) F, or the same war-and-hour%3 test: CAIUnit_ManageLandUnits. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-agents.md, section A. **On a load** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 39, read live 2026-11-11 entering a save at Italy's own A6 hour): the agents made before the first of the two passes tick in it with no unit (+0x64 nought) and return at the unit test; the first pass binds them, and each runs its land block once, in the second pass, with full_pass_pending set. **A new game, logged 2026-11-12** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 56): its agents tick first at 01:00 with no unit and are bound at the end of that pass; the full pass, with the air body forced, is at 02:00 - as section 39 has for a load.

struct_fields.name: regroup_air_pending
struct_fields.comment: 'This agent's air groups want regrouping.' Read, cleared and set by CAIUnit_ManageAirUnits, and set by CUnit_AttachToParent: it gates the split/merge phase at 0x4CE64F (`if (!this->+0x88 && !force) skip`), is cleared at 0x4CE67B before the phase runs, and is set back to 1 at 0x4CEA1D/0x4CEA30 whenever a wing was detached or merged. When it is still set after the phase the function returns 1 at 0x4CEE12 and assigns no missions at all that pass, so a pending regroup suppresses the whole mission half of the body. **Also set at 0x4CEC0F**, in the merge, **and by CUnit_AttachToParent at 0x1B9A0A** on the nearest agent above an air unit hung under another (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 56, a write watch on the running game 2026-11-12) - so the record's 'by CAIUnit_ManageAirUnits only' was wrong.
struct_fields.evidence: A write breakpoint on the Kwantung Army agent's +0x88 over twenty hours: writes at 0x4CE682 (clear), 0x4CEC16 (after the merge's set) and 0x1B9A11 (after CUnit_AttachToParent's).
